texts.preamble: Natvarbhai Narsinhbhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 25 April, 2018 Author: R.P.Dholaria Bench: R.P.Dholaria R/Cr.Ra/158/2002 Judgment In The High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad R/Criminal Revision Application No. 158 of 2002 For Approval And Signature: Honourable Mr.Justice R.P.Dholaria =========================================================== 1 Whether Reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to No see the judgment ? 2 To be referred to the Reporter or not ? No 3
texts.facts: 2. The short facts leading to filing of present Revision Application are that respondent No.2Shri Raval, while serving as Food Inspector with Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, purchased from the present applicant 750ml of cow milk on 10.11.1992 at 8.45AM on payment of an amount of Rs.6.75 for getting the same analyzed and on analysis by Shri K. A. Patel, Public Analyst, it was found that the said sample of milk did not conform the prescribed standards. Consequently therefore, a complaint came to be lodged by respondent No.2Shri RavalFood Inspector.
texts.arguments: 4.1 At the outset, learned advocate for the applicant submitted that Shri K. A. Patel, Public Analyst was not empowered to analyze the sample as at the relevant time, he was not appointed for the jurisdiction of Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation. He further contended that the said issue has been considered at length by this Court while delivering judgment in case of B. H. Patel, Food Inspector vs. Laxmandas Sevaram & Ors. reported in 2017(2) GLR 1709 and present case is also covered in view of said judgment. 5. In B. H. Patel, Food Inspector (supra), this Court observed and held as under: "Mr. Modi has drawn attention of this Court to the report at page 151 produced vide Exh.16 which is alleged to have been given by Public Analyst Mr.K.A.Patel on 20.12.1991 whereas the sample was sent on 26.11.1991. Mr.Modi also drawn attention of this Court to the notification issued by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat dated 24.9.1991 in exercise of the powers conferred by section 8 Natvarbhai Narsinhbhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 25 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145128431/ 2 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (the Act for short) amending the notification of the Health and Family Welfare Department dated 12.5.1988.
